issue: Secrets committed to repository (GEMINI_API_KEY, DATABASE_URL, API keys)
repro_steps: Open backend/.env in repository and inspect values.
suggested_fix: Rotate/revoke exposed keys immediately; remove backend/.env from repo; add to .gitignore; use secret manager; provide backend/.env.example.

issue: Arbitrary code execution risk: execute_code_locally runs user code without sandboxing; execute_code_via_piston silently falls back to local execution when Judge0 not configured.
repro_steps: Call POST /api/code/execute-raw or /api/code/run with code that reads files or performs network requests when Judge0 unset; observe host-side effects.
suggested_fix: Disable local execution fallback in production; require ALLOW_LOCAL_EXECUTION env opt-in; use an isolated runner (Judge0 or containerized sandbox with seccomp, cgroups, network disabled); enforce auth and rate limits on execution endpoints.

issue: /api/code/execute-raw accepted arbitrary files and executed them without auth, rate-limits or size caps (RCE + DoS).
repro_steps: POST a Python file containing system calls or large payload to /api/code/execute-raw and observe execution.
suggested_fix: Require API key dependency; add rate limiting and payload size limits; reject execution when Judge0 not configured; return 503 when execution unavailable. (Patched in repo.)
notes: Endpoint now requires API key and returns 503 if execution service unavailable.

issue: API key handling used plain equality and defaulted to empty string; misconfiguration returned 500; non-constant-time compare.
repro_steps: Unset API_SECRET_KEY and call protected endpoint -> returns 500; probe for timing differences when validating keys.
suggested_fix: Fail fast when API_SECRET_KEY missing in deployment; use hmac.compare_digest for constant-time comparison; return 401 for invalid keys. (Patched in repo.)

issue: Multiple issues: undefined variables used when saving submits (mcqAnswers/codingSubmissions), unsanitized LLM translation and hinting, DDL auto-migrations in request path.
repro_steps: POST /api/assessment/submit with normal payload -> server error; invoke translation/hint with large code -> LLM call; call endpoints with restricted DB role -> migration DDL may fail.
suggested_fix: Replace undefined variables with req.answers/req.coding_submissions or sanitized objects; enforce input size limits and sanitize before LLM calls; move migrations to Alembic/startup migration jobs and avoid DDL during request handling.

issue: Similarity threshold likely misconfigured (SIMILARITY_THRESHOLD=1.3) and no retry/backoff on embedding calls.
repro_steps: Call retrieve_context() for a relevant query and observe empty or incorrect results; revoke GEMINI key and observe unhandled exceptions.
suggested_fix: Confirm embedding distance/similarity metric scale and set appropriate threshold; add try/except around gemini embedding calls with retry/backoff and graceful fallback (cached embeddings).

issue: Model client uses global api_key and returns model outputs with little sanitization; errors expose misconfiguration.
repro_steps: Call RAG endpoints with missing/invalid key and observe exceptions; call with prompt that may trigger code fence returns and see unsanitized content.
suggested_fix: Centralize model client creation with robust error handling; sanitize/strip code fences and unsafe content before returning or persisting; log provenance and timestamp.

issue: Fragile result comparisons: direct stdout == expected equality is brittle to whitespace and canonicalization.
repro_steps:
Provide test where expected is 'Hello' and actual 'Hello
' -> marked failed.
suggested_fix: Normalize outputs before comparison: trim, normalize newlines, JSON-compare where applicable, and canonicalize expected values. Add per-language normalization helpers.

issue: Embeddings computed locally with SentenceTransformer model; resource-intensive and unbounded (RAM/CPU).
repro_steps: Run embedding script on large corpus -> high memory usage and potential OOM.
suggested_fix: Run embedding generation offline in controlled batch workers with limits; or use managed embedding service; add batching and per-item try/except.

issue: Crawler writes files to disk following relative links without path normalization; no robots.txt handling or robust politeness checks.
repro_steps: If a crawled page contains crafted relative paths, crawler may write outside intended directory; uncontrolled crawl may overload target site.
suggested_fix: Resolve and validate paths (Path.resolve()) ensuring they are inside output_dir; respect robots.txt; cap depth/rate and run off-line as a controlled job.

issue: Parses HTML and writes plain JSON; may retain HTML-derived text that could be used unsafely in frontend (XSS) if later rendered with innerHTML.
repro_steps: Parse HTML input with malicious content and later render in frontend using dangerouslySetInnerHTML -> XSS.
suggested_fix: Store plain-text only, escape HTML, or ensure frontend always sanitizes before rendering; avoid dangerouslySetInnerHTML for untrusted content.

issue: Deletes and recreates ChromaDB collection unconditionally (risk of data loss) and inserts items one-by-one (inefficient).
repro_steps: Run script -> old collection removed; slow insertion for wide dataset.
suggested_fix: Use atomic create-and-swap pattern, batch inserts, and backup old collection before deletion.

issue: In-memory cache not thread/process-safe (no locks) and no eviction policy; unsafe in multi-worker deployments.
repro_steps: Under concurrent access, race conditions may occur; multi-process deployment loses cache state.
suggested_fix: Add threading.Lock around get/set or move to Redis/memcached for multi-process deployments; add max entries and LRU eviction.

issue: Connects to ChromaDB and prints documents without error handling; may leak or expose data in logs.
repro_steps: Run script in production -> prints dataset to stdout/log.
suggested_fix: Avoid printing sensitive data; add try/except; use config-driven paths; restrict execution to admin/maintenance runs.

issue: Uses dangerouslySetInnerHTML to inject generated CSS variables; could be abused if config values come from untrusted sources.
repro_steps: If chart `config` contains attacker-controlled values, CSS may inject unexpected content.
suggested_fix: Validate/sanitize colors and ensure `config` cannot be populated from untrusted user input; whitelist accepted tokens or validate color strings.

issue: Custom markdown renderer implemented safely (no dangerouslySetInnerHTML).
suggested_fix: Continue to avoid rendering raw HTML. Consider adding more markdown features if needed.

issue: Third-party dependencies present; repo contains committed virtualenv and build artifacts.
repro_steps: Inspect repo -> backend/scraper/venv and dist/ directories present.
suggested_fix: Remove venv and dist from repo, add to .gitignore; run `npm audit` and `pip-audit` (or safety) and remediate critical CVEs by upgrading/pinning.
